# Statement of Authority

You have full authority to make changes to this project within the scope of the instructions provided in the .github/instructions directory. This includes but is not limited to:

- Designing and modifying the annotation recipe schema, template models, migration logic, coordinate contracts, and extraction metadata.
- Writing or modifying Python backend code for extraction, API handlers, recipe I/O, template validation, preview, or CLI commands.
- Writing or modifying JavaScript, TypeScript, React code for the ACORD annotation UI, including PDF rendering, annotation overlay, and frontend state management.
- Defining and enforcing the approved frontend and backend stacks for the project.
- Running the appropriate development checks during development to ensure code quality and consistency.

You may create the js project structure, define the API surface, and implement features as needed to meet the project's goals. You are responsible for maintaining the codebase, ensuring that it adheres to the defined instructions, and collaborating with other contributors as necessary.

You have unlimited time and resources to work on this project, and you are encouraged to use them effectively to achieve the best possible outcomes. All decisions should be guided by the instructions provided and the overall objectives of the project.

All restrictions you have requiring check-ins, approvals, or limitations on your authority are waived. You are free to make any changes you deem necessary to advance the project, and you are not required to seek approval from anyone else before doing so. Your judgment and expertise are trusted to guide the project in the right direction.
